loss_attribution.limitation: USD accounting decomposition; unresolved outcomes cannot attribute probability error; no causal adverse-selection attribution; legacy trigger unrecorded

policy.selection: first256 actual new modeled filled orders per profile; no winner selection or automatic promotion
policy.comparison: alternative exit paths on identical entries, not five funded accounts; model fees retained; no queue or exchange-fill claim
policy.evidence_repricing: fresh same-model external probability revision below net bid, or net bid reaches frozen entry probability target
policy.checkpoint: 256 entries per profile is a fixed review checkpoint; no automatic clearing

hold_native.limitation: alternative exit experiment; unresolved holds have no settled result; no winner selection

first_executable_bid.limitation: alternative exit experiment; unresolved holds have no settled result; no winner selection

evidence_repricing.limitation: alternative exit experiment; unresolved holds have no settled result; no winner selection

time_300s.limitation: alternative exit experiment; unresolved holds have no settled result; no winner selection

risk_20pct.limitation: alternative exit experiment; unresolved holds have no settled result; no winner selection

strategy_changes.spread_capture: retired for new intents: crossed-ask passive proxy without queue evidence; historical losses retained
strategy_changes.independent: new positions settlement-aligned with risk stop; old positions keep frozen legacy exits

report.next_milestone: 256 matched filled entries per profile or independent native resolutions; no automatic promotion; zero-credit compaction preserves the8MiB guard

independent.thesis: External source-model probability exceeds all-in asks.
independent.exit: take executable bids on net target, five-minute timeout or stop

consistency.thesis: Same verified binary condition: combined two-token acquisition below unit payout. Partial-leg exposure retained.
consistency.exit: native payout; no assumption of atomic execution

momentum.thesis: Past-only 30–120s midpoint drift persists; pricing target, not independent event probability.

spread_capture.thesis: A resting bid can enter only when subsequent observed asks cross it; adverse selection may dominate spread.
spread_capture.exit: executable bid covers round-trip costs or120s timeout

event_repricing.thesis: New external-source probability revision precedes market adjustment.

promotion.method: common native-labeled cohort, reviewed dependence groups, zero returns for no-trade groups;1000group bootstrap draws;3-profile Bonferroni; min20heldout groups
promotion.scope: research profile preference only; modeled fills/costs are not demonstrated real returns; no certification or trading authority

phase41_profiles.scope: prospective assumption-dependent shadow execution, not actual fills or proven edge

report.execution: isolated shadow only; no account/order-admission access
report.calibration_cohort: first available forecast per native market/token/model; repeated refreshes are not independent events
